name: thunder-solution/sdk
description: Official Thunder SDK for PHP: verify Thai bank slips and TrueMoney Wallet receipts, generate payment QR codes and check webhook signatures.

scripts.lint: find src tests examples .php-cs-fixer.dist.php -name '*.php' -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 php -d display_errors=stderr -l > /dev/null

scripts-descriptions.analyse: Run PHPStan at the max level over src and examples.
scripts-descriptions.check: Run the syntax, format, static analysis and test checks that CI runs.
scripts-descriptions.format:check: Check the formatting without changing files.
scripts-descriptions.lint: Check the syntax of every PHP file.
scripts-descriptions.test: Run the unit, conformance and README tests.
scripts-descriptions.test:coverage: Run the unit, conformance and README tests with a coverage report.
scripts-descriptions.test:integration: Run the integration tests against the live API (needs THUNDER_API_KEY).
